error_coordinates_out_of_range: Kļūda: koordinātas ir ārpus darbības zonas vai norādītas nepareizā secībā (vispirms platums, tad garums)
invalid_format: Nederīgs formāts. Izmantojiet 'platums,garums,platums,garums' vai 'platums garums platums garums'
world_scale_objects_skipped: Zem 0,30 ēkas un ceļi ir pārāk mazi, lai tos attēlotu, tāpēc tiek ģenerēts tikai reljefs un zemes segums.
new_version_available: Pieejama jauna versija! Noklikšķiniet šeit, lai redzētu jaunumus.
area_too_large: Šis apgabals ir pārāk liels un var pārsniegt tipiskos aprēķina ierobežojumus
area_extreme: Šis apgabals ir ārkārtīgi liels un var būt pārāk liels, lai to veiksmīgi ģenerētu.
area_extensive: Apgabals ir diezgan plašs un var prasīt ievērojamu laiku un resursus
update_modal_download_note: Lejupielāde tiks atvērta pārlūkprogrammā. Pirms jaunās versijas palaišanas aizveriet Arnis.
update_fetch_failed: Neizdevās iegūt jaunākās versijas informāciju. Pārbaudiet interneta savienojumu vai apmeklējiet GitHub tieši.
facade_mode_java_only: Fotopaneļi ir Java entītājas, tāpēc Bedrock un Luanti tiek veidotas tikai bloku fasādes.
settings_subtitle: Iestatiet, kā izskatīsies un darbosies jūsu Minecraft pasaule.
settings_section_world_desc: Kā pasaule spēlējas, kad tajā ienākat pirmo reizi.
settings_section_generation_desc: Izvēlieties, ko būvēt no reālajiem kartes datiem.
settings_section_nature_desc: Kas atrodas zem virsmas un kā aug koki.
settings_section_map_desc: Precīzi pielāgojiet izvēlēto apgabalu un karti, kurā to izvēlaties.
settings_section_application_desc: Kur tiek saglabātas pasaules un kā darbojas pats Arnis.
settings_section_advanced_desc: Iestatījumi modiem, saderībai un eksperimentiem. Lielākajai daļai pasauļu tie nekad nav vajadzīgi.
settings_section_features_desc: Extra controls for very large areas and experimental generation. Off by default.
settings_section_about_desc: Arnis ir bezmaksas un atvērtā koda. Paldies, ka to lietojat!
gamemode_survival_desc: Vāciet, veidojiet un izdzīvojiet ar veselību un izsalkumu.
mode_geo_terrain_desc: Ēkas, ceļi un daba uz reālā reljefa.
mode_geo_only_desc: Ēkas, ceļi un daba uz līdzenas zemes.
mode_terrain_only_desc: Reālais reljefs un zemes segums bez ēkām un ceļiem.
facade_source_off_desc: Sienas izmanto krāsas un materiālus no kartes datiem.
facade_source_preset_desc: Iebūvētas fotogrāfijas pēc ēkas veida. Tikai Java.
facade_source_mapillary_desc: Īstas ielu fotogrāfijas katrai ēkai, ja tādas ir.
world_type_desc: Kas atrodas aiz apgabala malas. Tikai Java.
map_item_desc: Sāciet ar visa apgabala karti inventārā. Tikai Java.
custom_world_name_desc: Nosauciet jaunās pasaules paši, nevis „Arnis World N”. Tikai Java.
overture_desc: Aizpilda OpenStreetMap robus ar satelītattēlos atklātām kontūrām.
three_dmr_desc: Slaveni orientieri, kā arī automašīnas, laivas, celtņi un vēja turbīnas.
interior_desc: Istabas, mēbeles un lādes ar laupījumu. Eksperimentāli un lēnāk.
signage_desc: Salasāmi ielu nosaukumi, ceļa zīmes un veikalu izkārtnes. Tikai Java.
fillground_desc: Akmens un rūdas zem virsmas raktuvēm izdzīvošanas režīmā.
caves_desc: Alas, pazemes upes un alu biomi zem pakalniem.
canopy_height_desc: Koki stāv tur, kur īstie, aptuveni to augstumā.
legacy_trees_desc: Vienkārši procedurāli koki detalizētu modeļu vietā.
max_tree_size_desc: Augstāki koki tiek aizstāti ar mazāku sugu.
mapillary_token_desc: Bez maksas vietnē mapillary.com/developer. Paliek šajā datorā.
facade_mode_desc: Pakariet pašas fotogrāfijas vai pielāgojiet tām sienu blokus.
facade_detail_desc: Augstāka detalizācija ir asāka, bet prasa modernu videokarti.
facade_precompute_desc: Uzbūvējiet izvēlētā apgabala fasādes pirms ģenerēšanas.
custom_bounding_box_desc: Ievadiet precīzas koordinātas, nevis zīmējiet kartē.
world_scale_desc: 1.00 ir reālais izmērs. Mazākas pasaules tiek ģenerētas ātrāk.
height_multiplier_desc: 1.00 ir īstais augstums. Lielākas vērtības padara pakalnus un kalnus augstākus.
rotation_angle_desc: Pagriež apgabalu, lai ielas sakristu ar bloku režģi.
map_theme_desc: Kartes stils, kurā izvēlaties savu apgabalu.
custom_map_source_desc: Jūsu flīžu serveris kā URL ar {z}, {x} un {y}.
anonymous_crash_reports_desc: Sūtīt anonīmus avāriju datus, lai palīdzētu uzlabot Arnis.
java_save_path_desc: Mape, kurā tiek veidotas jaunas Java pasaules.
luanti_save_path_desc: Mape, kurā tiek veidotas jaunas Luanti pasaules.
clear_tile_cache_desc: Dzēst kešatmiņā saglabātās kartes flīzes un fasāžu tekstūras.
disable_height_limit_desc: Paaugstina augstuma ierobežojumu 1:1 kalniem. Nav piemērots Realms.
aws_only_elevation_desc: Vecāks, rupjāks augstuma avots, ja noklusējuma avots nedarbojas.
bake_lighting_desc: Iepriekš aprēķināts apgaismojums LOD modiem, piemēram, Voxy. Lēnāk.
voxy_lod_desc: Tālais reljefs redzams jau pirmajā ienākšanas reizē. Tikai Java.
enable_luanti_desc: Pievieno Luanti (Mineclonia) kā izvades formātu. Eksperimentāli.
advanced_features_desc: Shows the options below. When off, Arnis runs as usual.
presets_desc: These settings and the OSM Data Source, as a file.
cpu_usage_desc: Share of the cores generation may use.
threads_desc: Exact number of worker threads. 0 is automatic.
ram_budget_desc: Memory a run may assume, in MB. 0 is automatic.
max_downloads_desc: Downloads kept in flight at once.
one_world_workers_desc: Pieces of a large world built at once. Requires One World.
unit_regions_desc: Regions in each piece; the selection snaps to whole cells. Requires One World.
snap_mode_desc: Whole cells inside the selection, or covering it. Requires One World.
square_selection_desc: Same number of cells both ways. Requires One World.
features_group_meld_desc: Changes what gets built: snow, roads, fields, trees, caves and water.
snow_mode_desc: Where snow lies on the terrain.
snow_percent_desc: Share of the height range under snow. Not for One World.
snow_y_desc: Snow lies from this height up.
rocks_desc: Small rocks on open grass and cropland.
bushes_desc: Small bushes on open grass and cropland.
rock_density_desc: Share of chunks that get a rock. Requires Rocks.
bush_density_desc: Share of chunks that get a bush. Requires Bushes.
road_detail_desc: How much road marking and minor ways to build.
no_buildings_desc: Roads, rail, water and land cover only.
loot_table_desc: Loot file for interior chests. Requires Interior Generation.
field_mix_desc: How farmland is split into parcels.
farm_crops_desc: Crop shares for farm plots. Empty keeps the layout's.
field_scale_desc: Parcel size against the layout's own.
tree_weight_small_desc: Share of trees up to 6 blocks tall.
tree_weight_medium_desc: Share of trees up to 12 blocks tall.
tree_weight_big_desc: Share of trees up to 20 blocks tall.
tree_weight_tall_desc: Share of trees up to 28 blocks tall.
preview_tree_tiers: Small to giant trees, left to right
cave_seed_desc: A different cave layout per seed. Requires Caves.
cave_datum_y_desc: Lines caves up between areas. Requires Caves.
river_bed_desc: Shape of river, canal and stream beds.
features_group_experimental_desc: Region files, climate, textures, build height, seed and props. Still being tested.
region_format_desc: How Java region files are stored. Not for One World.
blinear_level_desc: Compression from 1 to 22. Higher is smaller and slower.
climate_mode_desc: Where the climate behind ground and biomes is read.
climate_preview_desc: Draws the climate zones of the selected area.
climate_preview_done: Climate zones of the selected area.
grass_texture_desc: Mapped meadows as loose parcels of grass and flowers.
land_texture_desc: Untagged land textured from satellite land cover.
grass_mix_desc: Parcel mix for grassland. Empty keeps the default.
land_mix_desc: Parcel mix for textured cropland. Empty keeps patchwork.
world_floor_desc: Lowest Y of the world. Empty is automatic.
world_ceiling_desc: Highest Y of the world. Empty is automatic.
world_seed_desc: A different but repeatable look per seed.
props_desc: Which bundled props to place: cars, boats, cranes and more.
props_min_scale_desc: No props below this world scale. Empty places them at any.
tree_pack_dir_desc: Your own tree schematics. Empty uses tree-packs next to Arnis.
tree_pack_mode_desc: Whether your trees join the built-in ones or replace them.
tree_pack_layout_desc: Makes the folders, or fills them with the built-in trees.
tree_pack_missing: No folder there yet. Create Folder Structure makes it.
world_border_desc: Keeps players inside the generated area. Java only.
redraw_map_desc: Repaints the map item over every area. Requires One World.
settings_section_osm_desc: Where map data comes from, and building offline. The defaults are the usual downloads.
osm_source_desc: Where the OpenStreetMap data comes from.
osm_tiles_url_desc: Address of a tile archive. Empty uses Arnis's own.
local_archive_desc: Where baked countries are kept. Empty uses the cache folder.
arnis_tiles_path_desc: The baking tool, when it is not next to Arnis or on PATH.
overpass_url_desc: Servers to ask, comma separated. Empty uses Arnis's own.
osm_file_desc: An .osm, .xml or Arnis .json file covering the area.
osm_pbf_desc: An .osm.pbf extract covering the area. Empty downloads one from Geofabrik.
osm_pbf_bake_desc: Cuts the selected area out of the extract ahead of a run.
offline_mode_desc: Uses only data downloaded before. Fails and lists what is missing.
prewarm_desc: Fetches what the selected area needs, with these settings.
prewarm_first_desc: Downloads each piece's data first, one at a time. Requires parallel pieces.
data_plan_desc: What the selected area needs, and what is cached already.
data_plan_no_index: The Geofabrik index is not downloaded yet; the button fetches it.
data_plan_local: In the folder for this area: {names}
data_plan_local_none: No archive in the folder covers this area yet.
prepare_loading: Finding the countries that cover the selection...
prepare_missing_tool: Baking needs arnis-tiles next to Arnis, on PATH or in arnis-tiles Path. Get it from
prepare_none: No Geofabrik extract covers the selection.
prepare_stopped: Stopped. Countries already baked are kept.
map_tool_area_desc: Velciet pār karti, lai izvēlētos, ko ģenerēt.
map_tool_rotation_desc: Novelciet līniju gar ielu, lai pasauli izlīdzinātu ar to.
map_tool_clear_desc: Noņem atlasīto apgabalu un rašanās punktu.
map_tool_body_desc: Noklikšķiniet, lai pārslēgtos starp Zemi, Mēnesi un Marsu.
preview3d_controls_hint: Velciet, lai pārvietotu · velciet ar labo pogu, lai pagrieztu un sasvērtu
preview3d_buildings_too_large: Apgabals ir pārāk liels ēku slānim (maks. 10 km²)
one_world_desc: Katrs apgabals pievienojas vienai augošai pasaulei savā īstajā vietā. Tikai Java.
one_world_foreign: Mape “{name}” pastāv, bet nav viena pasaule
one_world_no_save_path: Vispirms iestatījumos norādiet Minecraft saglabājumu mapi
one_world_confirm_text: {count} šī apgabala chunki pasaulē jau ir. Tie tiek ģenerēti no jauna, un viss, kas tur uzbūvēts Minecraft, tiek aizstāts.
snap_fallback: No whole cell fits inside, so one is used.
